name: io.github.waj-1/ai-engine
title: WAJ AI Engine
description: Admin MCP server of a self-hosted AI agent platform: build, test and publish agents on your install.

engine_host.description: Host name (and port, if any) of your own WAJ AI Engine install, served over HTTPS, without the scheme. There is no shared hosted endpoint: run the engine first (docker compose up). For an install on http://localhost:8000, add http://localhost:8000/mcp to your MCP client by hand, as the README shows.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: An engine API key with Full access, created in the portal under Settings > API keys. A Chat only key is refused.
